question: whose jobs were done on june 9 and how big was each order?
gold_sql: SELECT c.name, COALESCE(wo.work_number, wo.id) AS job, SUM(woi.quantity) AS item_qty FROM work_orders wo JOIN customers c ON c.id = wo.customer_id JOIN work_order_items woi ON woi.work_order_id = wo.id WHERE DATE(wo.created_at) = '2026-06-09' GROUP BY c.name, COALESCE(wo.work_number, wo.id)
agent_sql_scrubbed:
SELECT wo.work_number, SUM(wi.quantity) AS total_quantity
FROM work_orders wo
JOIN work_order_items wi ON wo.id = wi.work_order_id
WHERE wo.created_at = ?
GROUP BY wo.work_number;
